audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart handed Maokai levels 2-3 and called 4-6 'Skill', while the whys prose said the opposite (Galio edges 2, 3, 4-5 and 6). Two layers agreed with each other but both contradicted the prose beside them, and the packet chart gave Galio 5/7 against a 53.64% Maokai win rate.
audit.why: Winds of War reaches 825 units against Maokai's 525-range Twisted Advance, so Galio genuinely owns the poke levels; Maokai's 53.64% comes from durability and item timings, not lane kill pressure.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Galio / Galio / Skill / Galio / Maokai / Maokai — Galio owns the poke window, Maokai takes over from first item. Proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phase text named 'first item' as Galio's spike and gave no real numbers for Hero's Entrance.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s — a spike you can time your own play around — and Heartsteel HP is exactly what blunts a single AP item.
audit.corrected: Level 6 written as Galio's (R on 180s, dive and roam), first item written as Maokai's (Heartsteel HP outgrows one AP item), with the 160s figure put into mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to 'bait his damage reduction down before you commit your root' and treated Twisted Advance as something Galio could answer, and it never mentioned that Shield of Durand is a 275-range taunt.
audit.why: Riot's text has Maokai 'becoming untargetable and dashing to the target' — the root cannot be sidestepped or interrupted once cast. And Shield of Durand only taunts at 275 range, so Bramble Smash's knockback removes him from his own taunt radius mid-charge. Sap Magic's cooldown also drops each time an enemy SPELL strikes Maokai, so Galio's poke pays for part of the healing it does.
audit.corrected: Written into tradeGood, wants.you[0], wants.foe[1], early, mid, whys[2], whys[3] and phases[2].why / phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown reference was the word 'Justice Punch' with no number.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7 and Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14 — the taunt, not the dash, is the longer punish window.
audit.corrected: 16s and 9s written into whys[2], whys[5], phases[2].why and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere said the W root is undodgeable.
audit.why: It is the single most actionable fact in the matchup and the mirror audit flagged the same thing from Galio's side.

Don't over-extend chasing kills I can't secure; instead shove the wave with E (Sapling Toss) and track when he R's away so I can match the play mid. My job here is to deny his poke and not feed his taunt-shield trade, not to solo-kill him.
